subject: planner: correct plan generation logic for PartitionUnionAll in Cascades framework (#62474)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for planner-only impact. Change set (1) adds `DataSource.PhysicalTableID` into Cascades Hash64/Equals to prevent different partition scans from being treated as the same memo expression, and (2) adds `LogicalPartitionUnionAll.PruneColumns` to preserve the PartitionUnionAll wrapper through column pruning (so later physical plan generation/MPP constraints still see it as `PartitionUnionAll`). Test harness was updated to run the analyze suite under Cascades as well. No remaining Blocker/High issues found after checking later upstream history for follow-up fixes.
